instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read a funnel that is written as stages pointing at workflow steps, offers, price options and measures, and see each stage's title, versions, price and conversion", and give it definitions (funnel-definition records: { kind, id, title?, stages: [{ stage_address, workflow_node_ref?, outcome_edges?, variant_surface_ref?, offer_price_ref?, price_option_ref?, metric_selectors?, title?).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-a-funnel-definition and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: A funnel definition is a list of stages; each stage points at records kept elsewhere (a workflow step that gives its title, a selection surface holding the versions being tried, an offer with the price option the stage shows, and measures that count who entered and who converted).
